notes: Setup for community exercise – we’re heavily trained to see negatives, gaps, to help, to fix. Going to take a break from that now and see what happens.
Sit with two other people you don’t know – in a triangle, no barriers, knees maximum nine inches apart.

Trios – take it in turns to answer the question ‘why is it important for you to be here’ (or – advanced version – ‘what crossroads are you at right now’). They can be as personal as they’re comfortable with. The other two take in in turns to deepen the enquiry: ‘and why is that important to you?’ repeatedly – and must refrain from offering help, advice, or asking specific questions. At the end of the exercise, each participants tells the others something they have appreciated about them. Recipient of compliment must say ‘thanks very much, I enjoyed hearing that’ (advanced version: ‘…please tell me some more’).
Builds quite deep connections, quickly, and links to
– they’re not here ‘because they are on the course’ but for a deeper reason.
